name: KSP DMP
author: rufanyin29@gmail.com
description: Dark Multiplayer mod server for Kerbal Space Program

variables.name: Game Difficulty
variables.description: Specify the gameplay difficulty of the server.

install.script:
#!/bin/bash


mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

V=$(curl -s https://d-mp.org/downloads | grep "DMP Server" | awk -F 'href="' 'NR==2 {print $2}' | awk -F '"' '{print $1}') # /builds/release/v0.3.8.3/DMPServer.zip

echo "Download link: https://d-mp.org${V}"
curl -sSL -o DMPServer.zip https://d-mp.org${V}

unzip -o DMPServer.zip
mv DMPServer/* ./

rm -rf DMPServer
rm DMPServer.zip

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
